scope_notes.summary: March 1994 flow at 30 W spans a described 6-8 S band, about 220 km meridionally. Two eastward cores are separated by westward flow; this is not fixed-depth full width. Nearby non-detection west of 30 W does not establish basin-wide reversal. Whole-current and annual dimensions remain unresolved.

widths.boundary_rule: Section 4.1 describes flow within 6–8 S. Paired velocity edges at a chosen depth and a reproducible threshold remain unextracted.
widths.extraction_method: Reported latitude limits converted to WGS84 meridional span, rounded to 10 km; midpoint is computational normalization only. No figure digitized or occupied footprint reconstructed.
widths.geographic_scope: March 1994 CITHER 2 section at 30 W, reported current band 6–8 S; local meridional span, not whole-current extent.
widths.layer: Two eastward-core contexts near 40 m and 240 m, separated by westward flow near 110 m. Reported band extends to at least 400 m in the section; its span is not a width at every depth.
widths.name: Atlantic South Equatorial Countercurrent
widths.range_interpretation: Converted local band span only. No uncertainty interval, uniform along-route width, annual range or continuous current axis inferred.
remaining_gates: Extract compatible depth-specific boundaries and exact section occupation days.
Resolve regional continuity and time/depth dependence before along-current route or annual dimensions.
widths.section_orientation: Reported meridional section span; no exact flow-normal reinterpretation or observed paired-edge geometry.
widths.source_citation: Bourles, Gouriou and Chuchla (1999), On the circulation in the upper layer of the western equatorial Atlantic, JGR Oceans 104(C9), 21151–21170, doi:10.1029/1999JC900058.
widths.source_locator: Section 4.1, printed p. 21156 / PDF index 5; Figure 3a caption, p. 21154 / PDF index 3; sections 2 and 2.2 instrument/sampling context.
widths.source_quality_note: Two eastward cores are separated vertically by westward flow. The nearby Meteor survey west of 30 W did not find SECC in spring 1994; regional/depth sampling differences do not establish a basin-wide reversal.
widths.time_convention: March 1994 section label; precise local occupation days unextracted. Cruise-wide dates are not assigned to this section.
widths.width_metric_label: described meridional band span, not fixed-depth full width
